'''Judin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], Judin had risen to the rank of [[Flight Commander/Legends|Flight Commander]], and he was in charge of recruitment for the elite [[Coruscant Aegis]] Squadron, a group of Republic-allied individuals who would strike at far-flung Imperial targets and complete missions too covert, specialized, or delicate for normal Republic forces.

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Judin contacted [[The Barsen'thor]], the [[Hero of Tython]], the [[Voidhound]], and the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc Squad commander]] and recruited them into the elite fighter squadron called the [[Coruscant Aegis]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Judin was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He contacts Republic players on board their ship by holocomm, just after they complete their Coruscant storylines and receive their own ship. He recruits the player into the Coruscant Aegis Squadron, which serves as the plotline for the space missions available to the players.<ref name="TOR" />
